  "fine_trace": [

      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 385,
      "var": "a = (mrb_float)mrb_integer(beg)",
      "code": "mrb_float a = (mrb_float)mrb_integer(beg);",
      "role": "source",
      "note": "The range begin is an input-controlled Integer; converting a large integer such as 9007199254740992 to mrb_float creates the loop counter used for allocation and iteration."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 391,
      "var": "(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1",
      "code": "ary = mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1);",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "The array capacity is computed from the floating difference, but there is no check that repeatedly adding 1.0 to a will progress and keep the number of loop iterations within this capacity."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 402,
      "var": "a <= b",
      "code": "while (a <= b) {",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "For 9007199254740992.0, a += 1.0 does not change a because the double spacing is 2, so the inclusive loop condition remains true after the allocated slot is filled."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 403,
      "var": "ptr[i++]",
      "code": "ptr[i++] = mrb_int_value(mrb, (mrb_int)a);",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "The loop writes successive mrb_value entries through ptr without checking i against the capacity allocated from (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1, causing a heap-buffer-overflow."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 385,
      "operands": ["mrb_integer(beg)"]
    },
    "root_cause": {
      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 391,
      "operands": ["(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1"],
      "relation": {"op": "le", "left": "i", "right": "(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1"}
    },
    "sink": {
      "file": "src/range.c",
      "function": "range_num_to_a",
      "line": 403,
      "operands": ["ptr[i++]", "mrb_int_value(mrb, (mrb_int)a)"],
      "relation": {"op": "lt", "left": "i", "right": "ARY_CAPA(RARRAY(ary))"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 385, "operands": ["mrb_integer(beg)"]},
        "to": {"file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 403, "operands": ["ptr[i++]"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["a", "b", "(mrb_int)(b - a) + 1", "i"]
      }

}
